what: The first 71 complete records (header plus 71 vehicles) of the EEA heavy-duty vehicle CO2 vehicle extract, byte-for-byte as served (UTF-8 byte order mark, CRLF line ends), cut at a record boundary.
fetched_by: lane S8-E1, one HTTP GET, first 190000 bytes of the response read, then the connection closed
